entries.よぉ!びっくりしたかい?\n・・・オレは、カレハチョウを\n集めてるんだ・・・\:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting butterflies...

According to rumors, butterflies have
mysterious powers...

If you collect a few, something amazing
seems to happen...

If you want to see what happens,
put the butterflies you caught
inside this Mukashio.
entries.なんだ・・・もう\nもってたのか・・・:
What... already?
Did you have it...?
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今 匹ぐらいだな・・・:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There are about X butterflies now...
entries.な!?…何だ、何だ?: What!?... What is it, what is it?
entries.・・・おりれなくなっちゃった\n\n花の種をさがしにきたんだけど・・・\nどこに:
...I can't go back anymore.

I came looking for flower seeds, but...
I can't find any anywhere...

I want to go home...
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nつれてってくれるの?\n・・・・・・ありがとう!:
...Big brother,
will you take me?
...Thank you!
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nそっちじゃないとおもうよ:
...Older brother,
I don't think it's that way.
entries.いや・・・\nどこにもいない:
No...
He's nowhere to be found.
entries.でも、このもりで\n見たドワーフいる: But, there's a dwarf I saw in this forest.
entries.でも、いくら 大ドロボウでも\nこんなところまでぬけ道つくるのは、とても大変・・:
But even for a great thief,
it's very difficult to create a secret passage like this...
entries.・・・うわぁっ!!!\n・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・\nなんだ、いつかのガ:
...Whoa!!!
...B-...I was startled...
Oh, it's that kid from before...
entries.い、いやぁ・・・\nやっと、ここから出してもらえてさぁ・・・\nけ、けっして ぬ:
I, no...
Finally, I've been let out of here...
I, I didn't escape at all...
Well then, I'll be going now...
entries.よぉ・・・お前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・\nどうだい?オレと ひとしょうぶしな:
Hey… I was waiting for you to come…
How about it? Want to hang out with me?
entries.じつは、この先の高見ヤグラのてっぺんに\nある宝をかくしておいたんだ\n\nそこ:
Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the very top of Takami Yagura ahead.
So, starting from the bottom of Takami Yagura,
if you reach the treasure faster than me,
I'll give that treasure to you...

How about it, doesn't sound interesting?
entries.はぁ・・・はぁ・・・\nお前さん はやいなぁ・・・\n\nしょうがない、オレのま:
Haa... haa...
You're fast, aren't you...

It can't be helped, it's my defeat...
I'll give you that map...
entries.いやぁ、ひさしぶりに\nたのしかったゼ\n・・・じゃあ、アバヨ!:
Wow, it's been a while since I had fun...
Well then, bye!
entries.ん? なんだい、くやしそうなカオだな・・・\nまぁ、オレはどうせ ヒマだからな・:
Hmm? What's wrong? You look frustrated...
Well, I'm just bored anyway...

If you ever want to try again,
feel free to talk to me anytime.
entries.よし! リトライだな・・・\nじゃあ、下におりようか・・・:
Alright! Time for a retry...
Well then, let's go down...
entries.あの鳥、ケガしてるみたいで\nあそこからおりられないんだ:
That bird seems to be injured,
and it can't get down from there.
entries.あの鳥、\nもどってきちゃったね:
That bird,
it came back, didn't it?
entries.このさき嵐の山・・・\n\nいつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・\nわし、:
This mountain ahead...

It's always windy, a very dangerous mountain...
I'm watching here, as told by the elder...
...but it's very boring...

So, I always practice here.
Huh? What kind of practice?

...Actually, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is very difficult...
What kind of face will make everyone feel...
entries.おおっ!そのカオ、\nそのひょうじょう・・・とてもいい!!\n\n・・・なるほど:
Oh! That Kao,
that hyojou... very good!!

...I see
...Hmm hmm
...Hmm, it will become very sankou.
entries.・・・う〜ん\n・・・でも、まだ何か足りない・・・\n\nたとえば・・・\n人に:
...Hmm...
...But something is still missing...

For example...
To convey sadness to people,
what kind of kao should I do?...
entries.ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!\nそ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・\n・・・:
Huh?... Whoa!
That, that Kaoshi filled with love! ...
...I see...

I mastered the laughter from earlier and the crying from now...
Hmm... hmm...
...nnn

I saw it!!
Yeah! Thanks!!

I feel like I can grasp something thanks to you!
Oops, I can't stay like this.
...From now on, it's over!!
entries.おっと、わすれてた・・・\nさっき、長老、山の方へ入っていった・・・\n\n何で:
Oops, I forgot...
Just now, the elder went towards the mountains...

Apparently, he has something to say to you...
You should go quickly.
entries.立ち入り禁止\nこの森には怪物がすんでいます。\n\nキケンですので立ち入らない:
No entry allowed.
This forest is inhabited by monsters.

Please do not enter as it is dangerous.
Baby Village Nature Conservation Office.
entries.おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・\n花のナミダ、恵みさまの復活にかかせない・・・:
I came to collect the flower tears...
The flower tears, they are essential for the revival of Eimi-sama...

But...
I don't know how to collect the tears...
entries.高見ヤグラの下のほう、\n木でできてるところ・・・\n\nこわれやすいから\n気:
The lower part of the Takami Yagura,
the part made of wood...

It's fragile, so you should be careful...
entries.あの、まんなかにいるのが\n恵みコゾウさまたち・・・\nでも、うごかない・・・:
Um, the ones in the middle are
the blessed Kozo-sama and others...
But they don't move...
entries.恵みさまが復活し、\n動きはじめるとき・・・\n何かがおこるといわれてる・・・:
When Ema-sama revives and begins to move...
it is said that something will happen...
entries.ここ、恵みの広場・・・\n魔ブタの魔法さえとければ、\nもっとキレイなところ・・:
Here, the Square of Blessings...
If only I could remove the magic of the Demon Pig,
there would be a more beautiful place...
entries.キノコの森には\n怪物がすんでるというウワサ・・・\n気をつけたほうがいい・・・:
There's a rumor that a monster lives in the mushroom forest...
You should be careful...
entries.そう言えば、恵みさまの\n動いてるところ・・・\nだれも見たことない・・・: Come to think of it, no one has ever seen Ema-sama's moving…
entries.わし、きょうは村の\n地下ロウの見はり当番・・・\n\nあれ?これ、\nないしょ:
Today, I'm on watch duty in the village's underground passage...

Huh? Wasn't this supposed to be a secret??
entries.この森も、昔はキレイな花が\nいっぱい咲いてた・・・\nこれもみんな、魔ブタのせ:
This forest too used to be full of beautiful flowers...
But now, it's all because of the demon pigs...
entries.魔ブタのかくれ家、\n目には見えないらしい・・・\n\nでも、入口は\nどこかに:
The devil pig's hideout,
it seems invisible to the eye...

But, the entrance must be somewhere...
entries.ここは・・・もう知ってるよね・・・: You already know this place, right?
entries.バッカスの湖にある水は、\nぜんぶアルコール・・・\n\nよっぱらうから、\n気:
The water in Lake Bacchus is all alcohol...

Because it's intoxicating, you should be careful...
entries.恵みさまを復活させるには、\nなにかが必要らしい・・・\n\nえ〜と・・・\nど:
To revive Ema-sama,
it seems something is needed...

Um...
I forgot...
entries.ん?・・・\n恵みさまを復活させるもの?\n\n・・・そういえば、なにかの\nな:
Hmm?...
Something to revive Eimi-sama?

...Come to think of it, I need some
tears or something...
entries.恵みコゾウさま、\n人気者・・・みんな、\nこの広場にあつまってくる:
Dear Blessed Kozo,
Popular... everyone,
gathers in this square.
entries.嵐の山にも魔ブタの魔法が\nかかっているらしい・・・\n封印ぶくろ、どこかにある:
It seems the magic of the demon pig is also on the stormy mountain...
The sealed bag must be somewhere...
entries.ときどき、森の地面の下から、\nものおとがきこえてくる・・・\nちょっとコワイ・:
Sometimes, from under the forest floor,
I hear footsteps...
It's a little scary...
entries.わし、村の入口ちかくにある、\nへんならくがきと同じもの、\n怪物マンションで見: I found something like a strange doodle near the entrance of the village, at the Monster Mansion…
entries.この先のリーフスライダーをぬけて、\nキノコの森を左に行けば、\n近道がある・・:
Go past the leaf slider ahead,
and if you go left through the mushroom forest,
there's a shortcut...
entries.キノコの森のむこうがわには、\n赤ちゃん村とバッカスの湖がある・・・: Beyond the mushroom forest lies Baby Village and Bacchus Lake...
entries.わしら、おまえに助けてもらった・・・\nだから、このタマゴおまえにやる・・・:
We were saved by you...
So, I'll give you this egg...
entries.なかま・・・みつかっていない・・・\nここからさきは いかないほうがいい:
I haven't found my companion...
It's better not to go any further from here.
entries.ドワーフのこども 迷子になった・・・\nもりのおくへ いかないように\nみはって:
A dwarf child got lost...
Don't go deep into the forest.
It's spreading...
entries.よぉ!びっくりしたかい?\n・・・オレは、カレハチョウを集めてるんだ・・・:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting butterflies...
entries.ウワサによると、\nカレハチョウにはふしぎな力があって・・・\n何匹か集めるとス:
According to rumors,
the butterfly has mysterious powers...
Apparently, if you gather several of them, something amazing happens...
entries.何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、\nつかまえた カレハチョウを\nこのムシカ:
If you want to see what happens,
put the butterfly I caught inside this mug.
entries.なんだ・・・\nもうもってたのか・・・:
What...
Did you already have it...?
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今・・・\n00匹ぐらいだな・・:
Hii... fuu... mi...
The butterflies are now...
About 00 or so...
entries.今回のバージョンは、ここまでです。\nこの先のエリアに進むと\nゲームは自動的に:
This version ends here.
If you proceed to the next area,
the game will automatically end.
entries.かみつき草の花: The flowers of the biting grass.
entries.地下ロウの大ドロボウ: The Great Robbery of the Underground Row
entries.とびっきりの泣きがお?: Is there a particularly big cry?
entries.わし、けっこうアタマいい\nおまえのコトバわかる・・・けど、\nおまえ、ドワーフ:
I'm pretty smart.
I understand your words... but
you don't understand dwarven words...

If you bite into our words,
you'll remember them...
It might take more than once though...
entries.コ○バ・・・\nわ○○○ない・・・:
Ko-ba...
I don't have a wa-wa-wa...
entries.な○とか ひ△しで\n◎●てきた・・・: I've been doing ◎● with な○ or ひ△...
entries.目のまえで、なかま\nいなくなった・・・: Right before my eyes, my comrade disappeared...
entries.どうしちゃったのかねぇ\nいきなり 4人も いなくなったんだって?\n\nきっと:
I wonder what happened?
Apparently four people disappeared suddenly?

It must be that again.
The Komabuta guys probably hid them as a prank...
entries.しんぱいだけど・・・\nほら みんな ちいさいだろ?\n\n高いところや ホウシ:
It's scary, but...
Look, everyone is small, right?

In high places or inside a cage,
you can't reach out...
entries.おやっ!\n・・・これ、くれるのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・\n\nそうだ、何か:
Oh!
...Is this what you're giving me?
I'm so happy...

Well, I don't really understand what's going on, but...
Please take this instead.
entries.・・・ふうーーーっ・・・じつは、\nおなかの中にガスがたまってて\nくるしかった:
...Whew... Actually,
there was gas building up in my stomach
and it was uncomfortable.

Thanks to that, I was saved...
Thank you...
Well, I don't really understand it,
but...

...Instead, please take this.
...It seems to be a rare item.
entries.この先、通さない・・・\nこれ わしのしごと・・・:
I won't let you through from here on out...
This is my job...
entries.ん?なんだ、おまえ\nこれ欲しいのか?\n\n・・・先、あぶないから\nきをつけ:
Hmm? What is it, you?
Do you want this?

...It's dangerous ahead, so
Be careful and take it...
entries.お〜い・・・ だれかいないかぁ〜\n・・・あかりがきれたぞぉ〜:
Hey... Is anyone there?
...The lights are out!
entries.こども!・・・こども見なかったか?\n\nこども、高見ヤグラに 花のたね\nさが:
Child! ... Didn't you see the child?

The child went to Takami Yagura to look for flower seeds... and hasn't come back!

Worried, worried...
Very worried...
entries.・・・あと6人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...six more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと5人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...five more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと4人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...four more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと3人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...Three more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと2人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...two more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あとひとりだけ、\nかえってこない・・・:
...just one more person,
who hasn't come back...
entries.おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!\n\nおまえ、とてもやさしいこころもっ:
Oh! You, child, did you help me!

You have a very kind heart... I am very happy.

Take this with you, it will surely be useful.
entries.こども見つけてくれて\nありがとう・・・\nわしとおまえ、ともだち:
Thank you for finding me...
You and I, we're friends.
entries.この花だんにお花咲かせたいなぁ・・・\n\nちょっと前までは、\n森にたくさんの:
I wish I could make flowers bloom in this flowerbed...

Just a little while ago,
there were so many seeds in the forest...

But now they've all withered...

I don't think it's just the evil pig's fault...
entries.もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if I'll never be able to see cherry blossoms again...
entries.おまえ、APと書かれた\nへんなモノ見たか?: Did you see something weird that said AP?
entries.わしらのなかま、あれと同じ\nマークの入ったトビラや箱も\n見たこと、あるらしい: It seems our comrades have also seen doors and boxes with the same mark…
entries.どうすれば、ひらくか?\n・・・気になる・・・:
How can I open it?
...I'm curious...
entries.くわしいはなし、ひろばにいる\nなかまがしってる・・・:
Detailed information is available on the forum.
My friends know...
entries.おお、おまえ、よくきてくれた!\nドワーフ、とてもこまってる・・・\n\nじつは:
Oh, you've come!
The dwarves are in great trouble...

Actually... this forest of dwarves,
is under the spell of the Demon Pig's magic...
The flowers and trees have all changed their forms...

Just now, four of my companions were surrounded by creatures in the forest
and their fate became unknown...

Probably, they're stuck inside the Houshi Manju attached to the tip of a pointed tree,
or perhaps they're trapped in the hanging Houshi Dama.

They're probably stuck to the Houshi Dama and can't move...

I've made it so they can't leave the forest until they find their companions...
Will you help my companions?
entries.たぶん、なかまは とんがった木の先の\n ホウシまんじゅうの中か\n\nぶらさが:
Probably, my friend is inside the pointed end of the tree,
inside the hoshi manju.

He's stuck to the hanging hoshidama and can't move…
entries.おお!\n\nおまえ・・・なかま、\nぜんいん助けてくれたか・・・\n\nほんと:
Oh!

You... comrades,
did you save everyone...?

Truly... thank you...
entries.こんかいのバージョンは、ここでおわり・・・\nおまえ、もっと プレイしたいなら\:
This version ends here...
If you want to play more,
please try the product banner...

If you helped your friends,
you'll surely enjoy this game...
All the dwarves are waiting!!
entries.・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・\nじつは、こどもがひとり・・・\n森:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...
entries.おまえ、とても、ゆうきある\nドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする:
You, very, have courage.
Dwarf, you, are scared.
entries.勇気ある少年よ・・・\nわしがドワーフの\n長老ですじゃ・・・:
A brave boy...
I am the elder of the dwarves...
entries.7人のドワーフは\nかえってきたんじゃが・・・\n\n子どもがまだ\nかえってこ:
The seven dwarfs
have returned...

But the children
haven't come back yet...
entries.子どもの両親は、この集落の\n入口のちかくの家におる・・・\n話をきいてくれんか:
The child's parents live in a house near the entrance of this village…
Will you listen to what I have to say?
entries.村人代表になりかわり、\n礼を言わせてほしい・・・\n\nなかまをたすけてくれて:
On behalf of the villagers,
I would like to express my gratitude...

Thank you very much for helping my comrades...

Since this is such a small village,
I can't offer much in return...

...That's right...
I heard a story from a 100-year-old man,

that he is watching over the fate of the demon pig...
entries.おぉ、あったあった、\nこれじゃ・・・:
Oh, there it is,
this is...
entries.これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの\n封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・\n\nこれが:
This is the Seal Pouch of the magical pig that cast magic on this forest...

With this, simply approaching where the magical pig is hiding should lead you to the entrance to its hiding place—the Magical Pig Gate...
entries.でも、魔ブタ、\n自分が魔法をかけた場所には\nかくれない・・・:
But the demon pig,
it doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...
entries.それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、\n1匹づつ封印できる\n\:
Moreover, each demon pig has its own sealing bag, allowing you to seal them one at a time.
...In other words, you need seven sealing bags for seven demon pigs.
entries.ふくろ、\n魔法をかけられた場所の\nちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・:
A bag,
near the place where magic was cast,
should definitely be there…
entries.魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、\nそれぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが\n一:
If you want to know where the Demon Pig is headed,
searching for each of its sealed pouches would be the quickest path...

But... the Demon Pig's power is immense...
Don't try to force it...

You probably don't need to look deep into the forest anymore...
Feel free to pass through freely...
entries.もう、森のおくを\n見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・\n自由に通ってくだされ・・・:
You don't need to look at the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.魔ブタ・・・\n自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・\n\n封印ぶくろあれ:
Magic pig...
It doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...

If I had a sealing bag,
I could find the magic pig gate...

But each magic pig has
its own sealing bag,
and I can seal them one by one...

In other words, for seven magic pigs,
I need seven sealing bags...

The bag should definitely be near the place where the magic was cast...
entries.ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・\n\nおまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・\nだか:
Dwarves are skilled at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you ever get into trouble,
you should ask one of our comrades...
entries.ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?\n\nでも、ドワーフが切るのは\nやくめをおえた:
Hmm... do you want me to cut down the tree?

But dwarves only cut down old trees...

For now, I'll follow you...
entries.・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・\nじゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・:
...Yeah, this tree will be fine...
Then, go back a little and wait...
entries.おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?\nこまったねぇ・・・\n\n実は、村のド:
Oh, are you also looking for an elder?
This is troublesome...

Actually, two dwarves from the village have started fighting...
Normally I would just leave them alone, but...

And of all places, they're standing guard at the entrance to the village,
so I can't get out anymore...

...Could you stop them?
entries.長老がいたら、\n一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・:
If there was an elder,
he would put an end to it in one shot…
entries.うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!\n\nそんなの すぐに見つかる・・・\n\:
I wrote it well, so it's okay!

That kind of thing will be found quickly…

After all, I should apologize!
entries.あの2人、長老から\n何かあずかってたらしい・・・: It seems those two received something from the elder…
entries.ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!\n\nおまえがわるい!\n\nいや、こわした:
Ho, ho... I found it after all!

It's your fault!

No, you broke it!
entries.ぶわっかもーん!!\nわしの大切なつぼを\nこわすとはなにごとゃ!:
Bwah! What's going on?!
You dare to break my precious pot?!
entries.ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・\nおまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといて:
Phew... I finally managed to get out of this hole...
Sorry, but could you fill this hole back up?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
Just as a side note,
...Hey, could you go take a look?
entries.ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、\nいちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、\:
Hmm... since you haven't come back for so long,
I returned to the village once,
but I got stuck in this hole splendidly...

Finally, I managed to get out of the hole...

...You,
could you please fill this hole for me?

...But who would dig such a hole...

I'll be waiting in the mountains again...
so don't make me wait too long...
entries.・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!\nぬけ道をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!\n\n・・:
...Ah! You're!
The kid who blocked the escape route!

...Good grief...
Just as I was about to run away when the pigs were distracted,
they blocked the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to that, I'm back on this street again...
Like a rat caught in a trap...
entries.これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか\nパン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・\n\nくそっ:
This isn't even a treasure of the mansion,
it's not even stealing a slice of bread...

Damn it, I'll show them!
entries.すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ\n・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・:
Supi~ sukaka ka ka... ngan go.
...Supyo pyo pyo pyo...
entries.おや、かわいいボウヤだね。\nでも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・\n\nわた:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But from the looks of it, he seems fine...

I may look like this, but I'm a doctor,
so come see me again if you get hurt.
entries.ボウヤ・・・\nわたしゃこう見えても\nいそがしいんだよ・・・:
Boy...
Even though I look like this,
I'm busy...
entries.みんなを助けてくれたんだって?\nけっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね:
I heard you helped everyone?
You're pretty good at this... thank you.
entries.あんたがケガしたら\nまっ先に見てあげるからね: If you get hurt, I'll be the first to check on you.
entries.おや、どうしたんだいその小鳥・・・\nケガしてるじゃないか!\nちょっと見せてご:
Oh, what's wrong with that little bird...
It's injured!
Let me take a look.

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・This will take a while, huh...

Boy, I'll take care of this little bird for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take care of it.

・・・Ah, what's the name of this bird?
・・・?
What... at least give it a name...

・・・・・・Baron?・・・I see, Baron.
・・・What a good name!
entries.しばらくしたら また、\n見に来ておくれ: Please come see me again soon.
entries.おまえ、森の外出るのか?\nだったら一度、近道行ってみるといい\n\nとてもキレ:
Are you going outside the forest?
If so, you should try taking a shortcut once.

It's very beautiful... and you can also see a large mansion in the distance.
Rumor has it there are treasures inside too...
You have courage, Kyomi. If you have the chance, you should go.
entries.・・・そういえば、むかし、\n近からこのむらに、魔王きたことある・・・\n\n森:
...Come to think of it, a long time ago,
the Demon King came to this village from near...

A mysterious crystal in the forest, apparently something the Demon King forgot...
Probably, the Demon King knows how to open it...
entries.おまえ、ともだち・・・\nまたあそびにこい:
You, my friend...
Come play again.
entries.おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!\n・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!:
Big brother! Big brother!
...Flowers have bloomed!
entries.そ○の◎◎の◎◎・・・◎◎に\nつな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?: That ○○'s ○○... ○○ is connected... Is it already ○○?
entries.◎の◎はあ●ないよ・・・: The ◎ of the ◎ doesn't have a ●...
entries.わ○ら、○ても◎△て○: I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.
entries.森の中、とてもあぶない\n・・・ぜったいダメ!: In the forest, it's very dangerous... absolutely no!
entries.そこの右側の入口・・・\n長老の家につながってる\n\n・・・でも、今みんな\n:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It leads to the elder's house.

...But everyone is busy now...
entries.おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・\nでも、まだ かんぜんには わからない\:
Oh! Did you remember a few words...?
But I still don't understand completely.

...Also, if I bite someone alone,
I think I can remember the words...
entries.ここ、ドワーフの村\n・・・なかまいなくなって\nおおさわぎ・・・:
Here, the dwarven village.
...it's no longer worth mentioning.
A great commotion...
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\nなかま、いなくなった!\n\n森にある小屋はとじてあるか:
Oh no! Oh no!
My friend has disappeared!

The cabin in the forest is closed,
so my friend must be somewhere in this forest…
entries.なかま、木にとりついた\nホウシにつかまって\n木にぶらさがってた・・・\n\n:
A companion, clinging to the tree,
Holding onto a fern,
Hanging from the tree...

When hanging, the fern stretches out
...It's very suspicious...
entries.このへんなキカイ、\n昔からここにある・・・\nわしらには動かせない・・・:
This strange machine,
has been here since ancient times...
we can't move it...
entries.なかまのこと・・・\nとてもしんぱい:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\n何がたいへんって、\nそりゃーもーたいへん!:
Oh dear! Oh dear!
What's so terrible?
Oh my, it's absolutely terrible!
entries.封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、\n森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの\nちょうろうがもっ:
Seal gloves? ... Speaking of which,
there's something called seal gloves in the forest.
Chorou has them...
entries.おまえ、友だち・・・\nまぁ、ゆっくりしていけ:
You, friend...
Well, take your time.
entries.かれはのなかに\nかわったチョウチョがいるらしい・・・\n\nおまえ見たこと あ:
He says there's a strange butterfly inside...

Have you ever seen it?
entries.あのイヌ、\nケガしてたんだってな・・・:
That dog,
I heard it was injured...
entries.ぶらさがっている まるい\nホウシダマ 見なかったか?: Hanging round, didn't you see the houjidama?
entries.森の中にある恵みの広場\n・・・もう行ったか?:
The bountiful square within the forest...
...Have you already gone?
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・ん?何の見はりか?\n・・・・・それはおしえられない・・・:
I… watch… hmm? What kind of watch?
…I can’t tell you that…
entries.なかま たすけてくれた\n・・・ありがとう: My friend helped me... thank you.
entries.そう言えば・・・\n始まりの森のかみつき草にも\n花が咲くらしい・・・\n\nで:
Come to think of it...
I hear flowers bloom on the biting grass in the forest of beginnings...

But we've never seen them...
entries.キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に\n山がある・・・でも、\nとてもキケンな山・・・: Beyond the mushroom forest on the right lies a mountain... but it's a very dangerous one...
entries.キノコの森には、\nいろんなキノコはえてるけど\nむやみに食べない方がいい:
In the mushroom forest,
there are various mushrooms growing,
but it's better not to eat them recklessly.
entries.高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?\nあそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・:
Have you seen the Noboru Kyo of Takami Yagura yet?
That scenery over there is very beautiful...
entries.このキカイこわれてる・・・\n\nたまに来る、赤い服をきたヤツなら\nなおせるか:
This machine is broken...

If it's the guy who comes occasionally wearing a red outfit,
I might be able to fix it.
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・\nちょっとたいへん・・・:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...
entries.わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・\n◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・:
Our ◎◎ has disappeared…
It's better if ◎ doesn't exist…
entries.わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・\n今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・:
Our comrades have disappeared…
It's better not to go into the forest now…
entries.わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?: Have you met our elder yet?
entries.たき先といえば・・・\n・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・\n\nそういえば、\n:
Speaking of firewood...
...It's yakiimo, huh...

Come to think of it,
there's a nice smell in the forest, you know...
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?:
Hanging from a sharp tree.
Houshi manju... Have you seen them all?
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅうの中に\nなかま2人 とりこまれ:
Hanging from a sharp tree,
inside a hōshi manju,
two companions were captivated.
entries.ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・\nとてもあやしい・・・:
The swaying fern...
It's very suspicious...
entries.ホウシダマがかぶさっている\n木の先のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・:
The houjidama is overlapping.
There should be two people among the tips of the trees…
entries.グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり\nつかまってた・・・: I was caught by Guragura-sanbashi, with one companion.
entries.高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん\n・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・\n回復する液:
Takami Yagura... It's wide and difficult.
... It's hard to find companions...
Recovery liquid, if you don't use it well...
entries.たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま\nつかまっているハズ: I'm sure there are two of them trapped in Takami Yagura.

According to rumors, butterflies have
mysterious powers...

If you collect a few, something amazing
seems to happen...

If you want to see what happens,
put the butterflies you caught
inside this Mukashio.

What... already?
Did you have it...?

There are about X butterflies now...

ん?・・・やけに

messages.original:

・・・おりれなくなっちゃった

かえりたいよぉ・・・
messages.translation:
...I can't go back anymore.

I came looking for flower seeds, but...
I can't find any anywhere...

I want to go home...

messages.original:
・・・おにいちゃん、
つれてってくれるの?
・・・・・・ありがとう!
messages.translation:
...Big brother,
will you take me?
...Thank you!

messages.original:
・・・おにいちゃん、
そっちじゃないとおもうよ
messages.translation:
...Older brother,
I don't think it's that way.

messages.original: いたか?

いや・・・

messages.translation:
No...
He's nowhere to be found.

messages.original:
やはり、
ただのウワサか?

いや、それ
わからない・・・

でも、このもりで
見たドワーフいる
messages.translation: But, there's a dwarf I saw in this forest.

messages.original:
でも、いくら 大ドロボウでも
こんなところまでぬけ道つくるのは、とても大変・・・
messages.translation:
But even for a great thief,
it's very difficult to create a secret passage like this...

地下ロウみにいく

・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・

...Whoa!!!
...B-...I was startled...
Oh, it's that kid from before...

messages.original:
い、いやぁ・・・

け、けっして ぬけ出したわけじゃないぞ・・・

messages.translation:
I, no...
Finally, I've been let out of here...
I, I didn't escape at all...
Well then, I'll be going now...

messages.original:
よぉ・・・お前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・
どうだい?オレと ひとしょうぶしないか?
messages.translation:
Hey… I was waiting for you to come…
How about it? Want to hang out with me?

messages.original:
じつは、この先の高見ヤグラのてっぺんに
ある宝をかくしておいたんだ

どうだい、おもしろそうだろう?
messages.translation:
Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the very top of Takami Yagura ahead.
So, starting from the bottom of Takami Yagura,
if you reach the treasure faster than me,
I'll give that treasure to you...

How about it, doesn't sound interesting?

messages.original: じゃ・・・いくゼ!

はぁ・・・はぁ・・・
お前さん はやいなぁ・・・

しょうがない、オレのまけだ・・・
その地図はお前さんにやるよ・・・
messages.translation:
Haa... haa...
You're fast, aren't you...

It can't be helped, it's my defeat...
I'll give you that map...

messages.original:
いやぁ、ひさしぶりに
たのしかったゼ
・・・じゃあ、アバヨ!
messages.translation:
Wow, it's been a while since I had fun...
Well then, bye!

messages.original:
どうやら、オレの
かち みたいだな・・・

ん? なんだい、くやしそうなカオだな・・・

messages.translation:
Hmm? What's wrong? You look frustrated...
Well, I'm just bored anyway...

If you ever want to try again,
feel free to talk to me anytime.

messages.original:
よし! リトライだな・・・
じゃあ、下におりようか・・・
messages.translation:
Alright! Time for a retry...
Well then, let's go down...

messages.original:
あの鳥、ケガしてるみたいで

messages.translation:
That bird seems to be injured,
and it can't get down from there.

messages.original:
あの鳥、
もどってきちゃったね
messages.translation:
That bird,
it came back, didn't it?

messages.original: この鳥 ケガしてるね・・・

このさき嵐の山・・・

いつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・
わし、長老にいわれて ここ、見はってる・・・
・・・けど、とてもたいくつ・・・

だから、いつもここで れんしゅうしてる
えっ?何のれんしゅうか?

・・・・・・じつは、わし役者になるのがゆめ・・・
役者になって、みんなを笑わせたり、
泣かせたり してみたい・・・

でも、れんしゅう とてもたいへん・・・
どんなカオすれば みんなかんどうするのか・・・
messages.translation:
This mountain ahead...

It's always windy, a very dangerous mountain...
I'm watching here, as told by the elder...
...but it's very boring...

So, I always practice here.
Huh? What kind of practice?

...Actually, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is very difficult...
What kind of face will make everyone feel...

messages.original:
おおっ!そのカオ、
そのひょうじょう・・・とてもいい!!

・・・なるほど
・・・ふむふむ
・・・んーとても さんこうになる
messages.translation:
Oh! That Kao,
that hyojou... very good!!

...I see
...Hmm hmm
...Hmm, it will become very sankou.

messages.original:
・・・う〜ん
・・・でも、まだ何か足りない・・・

たとえば・・・
人に かなしみをつたえるには
どんなカオすればいいのか?・・・
messages.translation:
...Hmm...
...But something is still missing...

For example...
To convey sadness to people,
what kind of kao should I do?...

messages.original:
ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!
そ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・

さっきの笑がおと、いまの泣きがおをマスターして・・・
ふむふむ・・・
・・・んーーーーーーっ

見えた!!
うん!ありがとう!! 

キミのおかげで何かつかめそうな気がする!
おっと、こうしちゃいられない
・・・今から とっくんだ!!
messages.translation:
Huh?... Whoa!
That, that Kaoshi filled with love! ...
...I see...

I mastered the laughter from earlier and the crying from now...
Hmm... hmm...
...nnn

I saw it!!
Yeah! Thanks!!

I feel like I can grasp something thanks to you!
Oops, I can't stay like this.
...From now on, it's over!!

messages.original:
おっと、わすれてた・・・
さっき、長老、山の方へ入っていった・・・

何でも、キミに用があるらしい・・・
はやく行ったほうがいいよ
messages.translation:
Oops, I forgot...
Just now, the elder went towards the mountains...

Apparently, he has something to say to you...
You should go quickly.

messages.translation:
No entry allowed.
This forest is inhabited by monsters.

Please do not enter as it is dangerous.
Baby Village Nature Conservation Office.

messages.original:
おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・
花のナミダ、恵みさまの復活にかかせない・・・

でも・・・
どうやってナミダ、集めるのかわからない・・・
messages.translation:
I came to collect the flower tears...
The flower tears, they are essential for the revival of Eimi-sama...

But...
I don't know how to collect the tears...

messages.original: ・・・こまった・・・
ここ、恵みの広場・・・

高見ヤグラの下のほう、
木でできてるところ・・・

こわれやすいから
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
The lower part of the Takami Yagura,
the part made of wood...

It's fragile, so you should be careful...

messages.original:
あの、まんなかにいるのが
恵みコゾウさまたち・・・
でも、うごかない・・・
messages.translation:
Um, the ones in the middle are
the blessed Kozo-sama and others...
But they don't move...

messages.original:
ココロあらわれるこのポーズ
・・・うつくしい・・・

恵みさまが復活し、
動きはじめるとき・・・
何かがおこるといわれてる・・・
messages.translation:
When Ema-sama revives and begins to move...
it is said that something will happen...

messages.original:
ここ、恵みの広場・・・
魔ブタの魔法さえとければ、
もっとキレイなところ・・・
messages.translation:
Here, the Square of Blessings...
If only I could remove the magic of the Demon Pig,
there would be a more beautiful place...

キノコの森には
怪物がすんでるというウワサ・・・
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
There's a rumor that a monster lives in the mushroom forest...
You should be careful...

messages.original:
恵みさま・・・
やっぱり動かない・・・

そう言えば、恵みさまの
動いてるところ・・・
だれも見たことない・・・
messages.translation: Come to think of it, no one has ever seen Ema-sama's moving…

messages.original:
わし、きょうは村の
地下ロウの見はり当番・・・

あれ?これ、
ないしょだったっけ??
messages.translation:
Today, I'm on watch duty in the village's underground passage...

Huh? Wasn't this supposed to be a secret??

messages.original:
この森も、昔はキレイな花が
いっぱい咲いてた・・・
これもみんな、魔ブタのせい・・・
messages.translation:
This forest too used to be full of beautiful flowers...
But now, it's all because of the demon pigs...

messages.original:
魔ブタのかくれ家、
目には見えないらしい・・・

でも、入口は
どこかにあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
The devil pig's hideout,
it seems invisible to the eye...

But, the entrance must be somewhere...

messages.original: ここは・・・もう知ってるよね・・・
messages.translation: You already know this place, right?

messages.original:
バッカスの湖にある水は、
ぜんぶアルコール・・・

よっぱらうから、
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
The water in Lake Bacchus is all alcohol...

Because it's intoxicating, you should be careful...

messages.original:
恵みさまを復活させるには、
なにかが必要らしい・・・

え〜と・・・
どわすれした・・・
messages.translation:
To revive Ema-sama,
it seems something is needed...

Um...
I forgot...

messages.original:
ん?・・・
恵みさまを復活させるもの?

・・・そういえば、なにかの
なみだが必要とか・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm?...
Something to revive Eimi-sama?

...Come to think of it, I need some
tears or something...

messages.original:
恵みコゾウさま、
人気者・・・みんな、
この広場にあつまってくる
messages.translation:
Dear Blessed Kozo,
Popular... everyone,
gathers in this square.

messages.original:
嵐の山にも魔ブタの魔法が
かかっているらしい・・・
封印ぶくろ、どこかにあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
It seems the magic of the demon pig is also on the stormy mountain...
The sealed bag must be somewhere...

messages.original:
ときどき、森の地面の下から、
ものおとがきこえてくる・・・
ちょっとコワイ・・・
messages.translation:
Sometimes, from under the forest floor,
I hear footsteps...
It's a little scary...

messages.original:
わし、村の入口ちかくにある、
へんならくがきと同じもの、
怪物マンションで見つけた・・・
messages.translation: I found something like a strange doodle near the entrance of the village, at the Monster Mansion…

messages.original:
この先のリーフスライダーをぬけて、
キノコの森を左に行けば、
近道がある・・・
messages.translation:
Go past the leaf slider ahead,
and if you go left through the mushroom forest,
there's a shortcut...

messages.original:
キノコの森のむこうがわには、
赤ちゃん村とバッカスの湖がある・・・
messages.translation: Beyond the mushroom forest lies Baby Village and Bacchus Lake...

messages.original:
わしら、おまえに助けてもらった・・・
だから、このタマゴおまえにやる・・・
messages.translation:
We were saved by you...
So, I'll give you this egg...

messages.original:
なかま・・・みつかっていない・・・
ここからさきは いかないほうがいい
messages.translation:
I haven't found my companion...
It's better not to go any further from here.

messages.original:
ドワーフのこども 迷子になった・・・
もりのおくへ いかないように
みはってる・・・
messages.translation:
A dwarf child got lost...
Don't go deep into the forest.
It's spreading...

messages.original:
よぉ!びっくりしたかい?
・・・オレは、カレハチョウを集めてるんだ・・・
messages.translation:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting butterflies...

messages.original:
ウワサによると、
カレハチョウにはふしぎな力があって・・・
何匹か集めるとスゴイことがおこるらしいゼ・・・
messages.translation:
According to rumors,
the butterfly has mysterious powers...
Apparently, if you gather several of them, something amazing happens...

messages.original:
何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、
つかまえた カレハチョウを
このムシカゴの中に入れてくれよ
messages.translation:
If you want to see what happens,
put the butterfly I caught inside this mug.

messages.original:
なんだ・・・
もうもってたのか・・・
messages.translation:
What...
Did you already have it...?

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今・・・
00匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mi...
The butterflies are now...
About 00 or so...

messages.original:
今回のバージョンは、ここまでです。
この先のエリアに進むと
ゲームは自動的に終了します。
messages.translation:
This version ends here.
If you proceed to the next area,
the game will automatically end.

messages.original: CLEAR!
ドワーフの長老
コトバを吸いとろう!
たき火といえば…
伝説のカレハチョウ
火が消えちゃった…
まいごのドワーフ
花のたね
AP・ピラー
ドワーフを数え
タルのゆくえ
森の封印ぶくろ
花の森
かみつき草の花
messages.translation: The flowers of the biting grass.

messages.original: ドワーフの助け
魔王の忘れもの
見えないカガミ?
ケンカをとめて
地下ロウの大ドロボウ
messages.translation: The Great Robbery of the Underground Row

messages.original: のぞいてごらん?!
ヨ〜イ…ドン!
バロンは友だち
これ、な〜んだ?
やしきの宝物?
水晶のじゅもん
とびっきりの笑がお!
とびっきりの泣きがお?
messages.translation: Is there a particularly big cry?

messages.original: 動かない恵みコゾウ
怪物?勝てるかな?
死神の巣をつぶせ
カギがかかっている
めぐみの羽根をつかった
マゴブタをつかった
ドワーフの迷子をつかった
ワライダケをつかった
ナキダケをつかった
げどくダケをつかった
バケツをつかった
ぼうえんきょうをつかった
ナミダのビン(カラ)をつかった
フラワーのナミダをつかった
あかの封印ぶくろをつかった
messages.translation: I used the red sealed bag.

messages.original: バンクの実をつかった
アルコールをつかった
エサねんりょうをつかった
ケガをしたコイヌをつかった
水がはいったバケツをつかった
messages.translation: I used a bucket filled with water.

messages.original: ちずをつかった
はやさレベル+1をつかった
かっとびのパンツをつかった
messages.translation: I used a pair of cuttobi pants.

messages.original: いだてんのパンツをつかった
べんとうをつかった
おおもりべんとうをつかった
messages.translation: I used a large bento box.

messages.original: ケモノダッシュをつかった
パラソルをつかった
グルドカをつかった
グルピンをつかった
ドカピンをつかった
ウッドブーメランをつかった
ストーンブーメランをつかった
アイアンブーメランをつかった
1UPをつかった
ライフゲージかくだいをつかった
ライフゲージぞうかをつかった
みえないカガミをつかった
ヤキイモをつかった
たいまつをつかった
カレハチョウをつかった
ドワーフを1人たすけた
ドワーフを2人たすけた
ドワーフを3人たすけた
ドワーフを4人たすけた

ドワーフを6人たすけた
ドワーフを7人たすけた
ドワーフのコトバ
ドワーフのコトバ レベル1
ドワーフのコトバ レベル2
ドワーフのコトバ レベル3
ケモノダッシュ
水てき 3分の1
水てき 3分の2
バケツをしまった
小鳥がにげた
小鳥をたすけた
迷子をたすけた
森の地下迷路
ドワーフの集落
ドワーフの集落の広場
う△ーー○!!
うわーーっ!!

わし、けっこうアタマいい
おまえのコトバわかる・・・けど、
おまえ、ドワーフのコトバ知らない・・・

わしらのコトバ、ドワーフにかみつけば
おぼえられる・・・
いっかいじゃ ダメかもしれないけど・・・
messages.translation:
I'm pretty smart.
I understand your words... but
you don't understand dwarven words...

If you bite into our words,
you'll remember them...
It might take more than once though...

Ko-ba...
I don't have a wa-wa-wa...

messages.original:
◎のまえ●、◎◎
いなくな△た・・・

な○とか ひ△しで
◎●てきた・・・
messages.translation: I've been doing ◎● with な○ or ひ△...

messages.original:
目のまえで、なかま
いなくなった・・・
messages.translation: Right before my eyes, my comrade disappeared...

messages.original:
なんとか ひっしで
にげてきた・・・

どうしちゃったのかねぇ
いきなり 4人も いなくなったんだって?

きっと あれだね
また コマブタたちが いたずらで
かくしちまったんだろうねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
I wonder what happened?
Apparently four people disappeared suddenly?

It must be that again.
The Komabuta guys probably hid them as a prank...

messages.original:
しんぱいだけど・・・
ほら みんな ちいさいだろ?

高いところや ホウシのなかだと
てが だせないんだよ・・・
messages.translation:
It's scary, but...
Look, everyone is small, right?

In high places or inside a cage,
you can't reach out...

messages.original:
おやっ!
・・・これ、くれるのかい?
うれしいねぇ・・・

そうだ、何かわからないんだけど・・・
かわりに これをもらっとくれ
messages.translation:
Oh!
...Is this what you're giving me?
I'm so happy...

Well, I don't really understand what's going on, but...
Please take this instead.

messages.original:
・・・ふうーーーっ・・・じつは、
おなかの中にガスがたまってて
くるしかったんだよ

おかげで たすかったよ・・・
ありがとうね・・・
そうだ、よくは わからないんだけど

・・・かわりに これをもらっとくれ
・・・めずらしいモノらしいよ
messages.translation:
...Whew... Actually,
there was gas building up in my stomach
and it was uncomfortable.

Thanks to that, I was saved...
Thank you...
Well, I don't really understand it,
but...

...Instead, please take this.
...It seems to be a rare item.

messages.original:
この先、通さない・・・
これ わしのしごと・・・
messages.translation:
I won't let you through from here on out...
This is my job...

messages.original:
ん?なんだ、おまえ
これ欲しいのか?

・・・先、あぶないから
きをつけてもっていけ・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm? What is it, you?
Do you want this?

...It's dangerous ahead, so
Be careful and take it...

messages.original:
お〜い・・・ だれかいないかぁ〜
・・・あかりがきれたぞぉ〜
messages.translation:
Hey... Is anyone there?
...The lights are out!

messages.original:
こども!・・・こども見なかったか?

こども、高見ヤグラに 花のたね
さがしにいったまま・・・かえってこない!

しんぱい、しんぱい・・・
とてもしんぱい・・・
messages.translation:
Child! ... Didn't you see the child?

The child went to Takami Yagura to look for flower seeds... and hasn't come back!

Worried, worried...
Very worried...

messages.original:
・・・まだひとりも、
かえってこない・・・

・・・あと6人、
かえってこない・・・
messages.translation:
...six more people,
they won't come back...

messages.original:
・・・あと5人、
かえってこない・・・
messages.translation:
...five more people,
they won't come back...

messages.original:
・・・あと4人、
かえってこない・・・
messages.translation:
...four more people,
they won't come back...

messages.original:
・・・あと3人、
かえってこない・・・
messages.translation:
...Three more people,
they won't come back...

messages.original:
・・・あと2人、
かえってこない・・・
messages.translation:
...two more people,
they won't come back...

messages.original:
・・・あとひとりだけ、
かえってこない・・・
messages.translation:
...just one more person,
who hasn't come back...

messages.original:
しんぱい、しんぱい・・・
とてもしんぱい・・・

おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!

おまえ、とてもやさしいこころもってる
・・・わし、とてもうれしい

おれいに、これ、もってゆけ、きっとやくにたつ
messages.translation:
Oh! You, child, did you help me!

You have a very kind heart... I am very happy.

Take this with you, it will surely be useful.

messages.original:
こども見つけてくれて
ありがとう・・・
わしとおまえ、ともだち
messages.translation:
Thank you for finding me...
You and I, we're friends.

messages.original:
おにいちゃん、
花のたね みつけたら
おしえてね!

この花だんにお花咲かせたいなぁ・・・

ちょっと前までは、
森にたくさんの種があったんだよ・・・

でも、今はみんなしおれてた・・・

魔ブタのせいだけじゃないような気がするんだけど・・・
messages.translation:
I wish I could make flowers bloom in this flowerbed...

Just a little while ago,
there were so many seeds in the forest...

But now they've all withered...

I don't think it's just the evil pig's fault...

messages.original: もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・
messages.translation: I wonder if I'll never be able to see cherry blossoms again...

messages.original:
おまえ、APと書かれた
へんなモノ見たか?
messages.translation: Did you see something weird that said AP?

messages.original:
わしらのなかま、あれと同じ
マークの入ったトビラや箱も
見たこと、あるらしい・・・
messages.translation: It seems our comrades have also seen doors and boxes with the same mark…

messages.original:
どうすれば、ひらくか?
・・・気になる・・・
messages.translation:
How can I open it?
...I'm curious...

messages.original:
ドワーフ、
とてもこまってる・・・

くわしいはなし、ひろばにいる
なかまがしってる・・・
messages.translation:
Detailed information is available on the forum.
My friends know...

messages.original:
おお、おまえ、よくきてくれた!
ドワーフ、とてもこまってる・・・

じつは・・・このドワーフの森、
魔ブタの魔法かかってる・・・
花々はかれ、木々たちも すがた変えた・・・

さっき、4人の なかま、森で しょくぶつに取り囲まれ
ゆくえ知れずになった・・・

たぶん、とんがった木の先にくっついた
 ホウシまんじゅうの中か

ぶらさがったホウシダマに取り付かれて
うごけなくなってるハズ・・・

なかま 見つかるまで 森のおくいけないように
してある・・・
おまえ なかま 助けてくれないか・・・
messages.translation:
Oh, you've come!
The dwarves are in great trouble...

Actually... this forest of dwarves,
is under the spell of the Demon Pig's magic...
The flowers and trees have all changed their forms...

Just now, four of my companions were surrounded by creatures in the forest
and their fate became unknown...

Probably, they're stuck inside the Houshi Manju attached to the tip of a pointed tree,
or perhaps they're trapped in the hanging Houshi Dama.

They're probably stuck to the Houshi Dama and can't move...

I've made it so they can't leave the forest until they find their companions...
Will you help my companions?

messages.original:
たぶん、なかまは とんがった木の先の
 ホウシまんじゅうの中か

ぶらさがったホウシダマに取り付かれて
うごけなくなってるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
Probably, my friend is inside the pointed end of the tree,
inside the hoshi manju.

He's stuck to the hanging hoshidama and can't move…

messages.original:
おお!

おまえ・・・なかま、
ぜんいん助けてくれたか・・・

ほんとうに・・・ありがとう・・・
messages.translation:
Oh!

You... comrades,
did you save everyone...?

Truly... thank you...

messages.original:
こんかいのバージョンは、ここでおわり・・・
おまえ、もっと プレイしたいなら
ぜひ せいひんばんを あそんでくれ・・・・

なかま たすけてくれた おまえなら
このゲーム きっと たのしいハズ・・・
ドワーフ みんな まってる!!
messages.translation:
This version ends here...
If you want to play more,
please try the product banner...

If you helped your friends,
you'll surely enjoy this game...
All the dwarves are waiting!!

messages.original:
・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・
じつは、こどもがひとり・・・
森のなかで迷子になったまま・・・
messages.translation:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...

messages.original:
おまえ、とても、ゆうきある
ドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする
messages.translation:
You, very, have courage.
Dwarf, you, are scared.

messages.original:
勇気ある少年よ・・・
わしがドワーフの
長老ですじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
A brave boy...
I am the elder of the dwarves...

messages.original:
7人のドワーフは
かえってきたんじゃが・・・

子どもがまだ
かえってこないんじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
The seven dwarfs
have returned...

But the children
haven't come back yet...

messages.original:
子どもの両親は、この集落の
入口のちかくの家におる・・・
話をきいてくれんかのぅ・・
messages.translation:
The child's parents live in a house near the entrance of this village…
Will you listen to what I have to say?

messages.original:
村人代表になりかわり、
礼を言わせてほしい・・・

なかまをたすけてくれて
本当にありがとう・・・

こんな村じゃから、
たいしたお礼も
できないんじゃが・・・

・・・そうじゃ・・・
100年老人から話は
聞いたんじゃが、

魔ブタのゆくえを
おっているとか・・・
messages.translation:
On behalf of the villagers,
I would like to express my gratitude...

Thank you very much for helping my comrades...

Since this is such a small village,
I can't offer much in return...

...That's right...
I heard a story from a 100-year-old man,

that he is watching over the fate of the demon pig...

messages.original:
おぉ、あったあった、
これじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
Oh, there it is,
this is...

messages.original:
これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの
封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・

これがあれば魔ブタのかくれている場所へ近づくだけで、
かくれ場所への入口、すなわち魔ブタゲートを
見つけてくれるハズじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
This is the Seal Pouch of the magical pig that cast magic on this forest...

With this, simply approaching where the magical pig is hiding should lead you to the entrance to its hiding place—the Magical Pig Gate...

messages.original:
でも、魔ブタ、
自分が魔法をかけた場所には
かくれない・・・
messages.translation:
But the demon pig,
it doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...

messages.original:
それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、
1匹づつ封印できる

・・・つまり、7匹の魔ブタに対して
7つの封印ぶくろが必要なわけじゃ
messages.translation:
Moreover, each demon pig has its own sealing bag, allowing you to seal them one at a time.
...In other words, you need seven sealing bags for seven demon pigs.

messages.original:
ふくろ、
魔法をかけられた場所の
ちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
A bag,
near the place where magic was cast,
should definitely be there…

messages.original:
魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、
それぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが
一番の近道じゃろう・・・

しかし・・・魔ブタの力は強大じゃ・・・
ムリはせんようにな・・・

もう、森のおくを見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・
自由に通ってくだされ・・・
messages.translation:
If you want to know where the Demon Pig is headed,
searching for each of its sealed pouches would be the quickest path...

But... the Demon Pig's power is immense...
Don't try to force it...

You probably don't need to look deep into the forest anymore...
Feel free to pass through freely...

messages.original:
もう、森のおくを
見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・
自由に通ってくだされ・・・
messages.translation:
You don't need to look at the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...

messages.original:
魔ブタ・・・
自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・

封印ぶくろあれば
魔ブタゲート見つけることできる・・・

でも、魔ブタには
それぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあって、
1匹づつ封印できる・・・

つまり、7匹の魔ブタに対して
7つの封印ぶくろ ひつよう・・・

ふくろ、魔法をかけられた場所のちかくに
必ずあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
Magic pig...
It doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...

If I had a sealing bag,
I could find the magic pig gate...

But each magic pig has
its own sealing bag,
and I can seal them one by one...

In other words, for seven magic pigs,
I need seven sealing bags...

The bag should definitely be near the place where the magic was cast...

messages.original:
ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・

おまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・
だからおまえも困ったことあったら、
わしらの なかまにたのむといい・・・
messages.translation:
Dwarves are skilled at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you ever get into trouble,
you should ask one of our comrades...

messages.original:
ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?

でも、ドワーフが切るのは
やくめをおえた ふるい木だけ・・・

とりあえず、おまえのあとついていく・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm... do you want me to cut down the tree?

But dwarves only cut down old trees...

For now, I'll follow you...

messages.original:
・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・
じゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・・
messages.translation:
...Yeah, this tree will be fine...
Then, go back a little and wait...

messages.original:
おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?
こまったねぇ・・・

実は、村のドワーフ2人が
ケンカをはじめちやってね・・・
いつもだったら、ほっとくんだけど・・・

よりによって、村の入り口でもみ張ってるから、
外に出られなくなっちゃったんだ・・・

・・・あんた、とめてくれないかい?
messages.translation:
Oh, are you also looking for an elder?
This is troublesome...

Actually, two dwarves from the village have started fighting...
Normally I would just leave them alone, but...

And of all places, they're standing guard at the entrance to the village,
so I can't get out anymore...

...Could you stop them?

messages.original:
長老がいたら、
一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
If there was an elder,
he would put an end to it in one shot…

messages.original:
うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!

そんなの すぐに見つかる・・・

やっぱり、あやまったほうがいい!
messages.translation:
I wrote it well, so it's okay!

That kind of thing will be found quickly…

After all, I should apologize!

messages.original:
何か こわしたとか
なんとか・・・

あの2人、長老から
何かあずかってたらしい・・・
messages.translation: It seems those two received something from the elder…

messages.original:
ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!

おまえがわるい!

いや、こわしたのは おまえ!
messages.translation:
Ho, ho... I found it after all!

It's your fault!

No, you broke it!

messages.original:
ぶわっかもーん!!
わしの大切なつぼを
こわすとはなにごとゃ!
messages.translation:
Bwah! What's going on?!
You dare to break my precious pot?!

messages.original: ご、ごめんなさーい・・・

ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・
おまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといてくれんか?

・・・しかし、だれがこんな穴をほったんじゃろうな・・・

・・・ん?なんじゃ?なんだか外がさわがしいのぉ・・・
ことのついでじゃ
・・・おまえさん ちょっと見てきてくれんか?
messages.translation:
Phew... I finally managed to get out of this hole...
Sorry, but could you fill this hole back up?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
Just as a side note,
...Hey, could you go take a look?

messages.original:
ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、
いちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、
この穴にみごとにハマってのぉ・・・

やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・

・・・おまえさん、
悪いがこの穴をうめといてくれんか?

・・・しかし、だれがこんな穴を
ほったんじゃろうな・・・

わしはまた、山でまっておるからの・・・
あまり、としよりをまたせるでないぞ・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm... since you haven't come back for so long,
I returned to the village once,
but I got stuck in this hole splendidly...

Finally, I managed to get out of the hole...

...You,
could you please fill this hole for me?

...But who would dig such a hole...

I'll be waiting in the mountains again...
so don't make me wait too long...

messages.original:
・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!
ぬけ道をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!

・・・ったく・・・
コマブタ達のすきを見てにげ出そうとしたら、
目の前で出口をふさいじまいやがって・・・

おかげでこの通り、
また ろうやにぎゃく戻りさ・・・
messages.translation:
...Ah! You're!
The kid who blocked the escape route!

...Good grief...
Just as I was about to run away when the pigs were distracted,
they blocked the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to that, I'm back on this street again...
Like a rat caught in a trap...

messages.original:
これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか
パン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・

くそっ、ふてねしてやる!
messages.translation:
This isn't even a treasure of the mansion,
it's not even stealing a slice of bread...

Damn it, I'll show them!

messages.original:
すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ
・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・
messages.translation:
Supi~ sukaka ka ka... ngan go.
...Supyo pyo pyo pyo...

messages.original:
おや、かわいいボウヤだね。
でも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・

わたしゃこう見えても医者だからね、
ケガでもしたらまたおいで
messages.translation:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But from the looks of it, he seems fine...

I may look like this, but I'm a doctor,
so come see me again if you get hurt.

messages.original:
ボウヤ・・・
わたしゃこう見えても
いそがしいんだよ・・・
messages.translation:
Boy...
Even though I look like this,
I'm busy...

messages.original:
みんなを助けてくれたんだって?
けっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね
messages.translation:
I heard you helped everyone?
You're pretty good at this... thank you.

messages.original:
あんたがケガしたら
まっ先に見てあげるからね
messages.translation: If you get hurt, I'll be the first to check on you.

messages.original:
おや、どうしたんだいその小鳥・・・
ケガしてるじゃないか!
ちょっと見せてごらん

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・これはちょっとじかんがかかりそうだね・・・

ボウヤ、この小鳥しばらく私があずかるよ・・・
なぁに心配はいらないよ、
わたしがせきにんもって みるからさ

・・・あぁ、この鳥なんて名前だい?
・・・・?
なんだい・・・名前ぐらい付けてあげなよ・・・

・・・・・・バロン?・・・そうか、バロンか
・・・いい名前じゃないか!
messages.translation:
Oh, what's wrong with that little bird...
It's injured!
Let me take a look.

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・This will take a while, huh...

Boy, I'll take care of this little bird for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take care of it.

・・・Ah, what's the name of this bird?
・・・?
What... at least give it a name...

・・・・・・Baron?・・・I see, Baron.
・・・What a good name!

messages.original:
しばらくしたら また、
見に来ておくれ
messages.translation: Please come see me again soon.

messages.original:
おまえ、森の外出るのか?
だったら一度、近道行ってみるといい

とてもキレイ・・・とおくに大きな屋敷も見える
ウワサでは宝物もあるらしい・・・
おまえ、勇気ある、キョウミあったら行ってみるといい
messages.translation:
Are you going outside the forest?
If so, you should try taking a shortcut once.

It's very beautiful... and you can also see a large mansion in the distance.
Rumor has it there are treasures inside too...
You have courage, Kyomi. If you have the chance, you should go.

messages.original:
・・・そういえば、むかし、
近からこのむらに、魔王きたことある・・・

森にあるふしぎな水晶、魔王のわすれものらしい・・・
たぶん、開けかたは魔王が知ってる・・・
messages.translation:
...Come to think of it, a long time ago,
the Demon King came to this village from near...

A mysterious crystal in the forest, apparently something the Demon King forgot...
Probably, the Demon King knows how to open it...

messages.original:
おまえ、ともだち・・・
またあそびにこい
messages.translation:
You, my friend...
Come play again.

messages.original:
おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!
・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!
messages.translation:
Big brother! Big brother!
...Flowers have bloomed!

messages.original: わく わく!・・・
キレイだね・・・
・・・楽しみだね

た○へ○だ!た○へ○だぁ!

たいへんだ!たいへんだぁ!

つな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?
messages.translation: That ○○'s ○○... ○○ is connected... Is it already ○○?

いなくな△た・・・

◎●てきた・・・
messages.translation: I've been doing ◎● with な○ or ひ△...

ね△、◎△て○いいでし△・・・

messages.translation: The ◎ of the ◎ doesn't have a ●...

messages.translation: I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.

messages.original: わ○ら、○ても◎△て○
messages.translation: I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.

messages.original: な○まの○と・・・とても○ん◎い

な○まの○と・・・
と○も○ん◎い
ねぇ、行ってもいいでしょ・・・

森の中、とてもあぶない
・・・ぜったいダメ!
messages.translation: In the forest, it's very dangerous... absolutely no!

messages.original:
そこの右側の入口・・・
長老の家につながってる

・・・でも、今みんな
いそがしい・・・
messages.translation:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It leads to the elder's house.

...But everyone is busy now...

messages.original:
おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・
でも、まだ かんぜんには わからない

・・・あと、ひとりに かみつけば
たぶんコトバおぼえられる・・・
messages.translation:
Oh! Did you remember a few words...?
But I still don't understand completely.

...Also, if I bite someone alone,
I think I can remember the words...

messages.original:
ここ、ドワーフの村
・・・なかまいなくなって
おおさわぎ・・・
messages.translation:
Here, the dwarven village.
...it's no longer worth mentioning.
A great commotion...

messages.original:
たいへん!たいへん!
なかま、いなくなった!

森にある小屋はとじてあるから
なかま きっと このもりの
どこかに いるはず・・・
messages.translation:
Oh no! Oh no!
My friend has disappeared!

The cabin in the forest is closed,
so my friend must be somewhere in this forest…

messages.original:
目のまえで、なかま
いなくなった・・・
messages.translation: Right before my eyes, my comrade disappeared...

messages.original:
なかま、木にとりついた
ホウシにつかまって
木にぶらさがってた・・・

ぶらさがると のびるホウシダマ
・・・とても あやしい・・・
messages.translation:
A companion, clinging to the tree,
Holding onto a fern,
Hanging from the tree...

When hanging, the fern stretches out
...It's very suspicious...

messages.original:
このへんなキカイ、
昔からここにある・・・
わしらには動かせない・・・
messages.translation:
This strange machine,
has been here since ancient times...
we can't move it...

messages.original: わし・・・長老のいちばんでし

なんとか ひっしで
にげてきた・・・

なかまのこと・・・
とてもしんぱい
messages.translation:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.

messages.original:
たいへん!たいへん!
何がたいへんって、
そりゃーもーたいへん!
messages.translation:
Oh dear! Oh dear!
What's so terrible?
Oh my, it's absolutely terrible!

messages.original:
みんなのこと・・・
とてもしんぱい

封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、
森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの
ちょうろうがもってる・・・
messages.translation:
Seal gloves? ... Speaking of which,
there's something called seal gloves in the forest.
Chorou has them...

messages.original:
おまえ、友だち・・・
まぁ、ゆっくりしていけ
messages.translation:
You, friend...
Well, take your time.

messages.original:
かれはのなかに
かわったチョウチョがいるらしい・・・

おまえ見たこと あるか?
messages.translation:
He says there's a strange butterfly inside...

Have you ever seen it?

messages.original:
あのイヌ、
ケガしてたんだってな・・・
messages.translation:
That dog,
I heard it was injured...

messages.original:
ぶらさがっている まるい
ホウシダマ 見なかったか?
messages.translation: Hanging round, didn't you see the houjidama?

messages.original:
森の中にある恵みの広場
・・・もう行ったか?
messages.translation:
The bountiful square within the forest...
...Have you already gone?

messages.original:
なかまのこと
とてもしんぱい

わし・・・見はり・・・ん?何の見はりか?
・・・・・それはおしえられない・・・
messages.translation:
I… watch… hmm? What kind of watch?
…I can’t tell you that…

messages.original: 長老にはもうあったか?

なかま たすけてくれた
・・・ありがとう
messages.translation: My friend helped me... thank you.

messages.original:
そう言えば・・・
始まりの森のかみつき草にも
花が咲くらしい・・・

でも、わしら見たことない・・・
messages.translation:
Come to think of it...
I hear flowers bloom on the biting grass in the forest of beginnings...

But we've never seen them...

messages.original:
キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に
山がある・・・でも、
とてもキケンな山・・・
messages.translation: Beyond the mushroom forest on the right lies a mountain... but it's a very dangerous one...

messages.original:
キノコの森には、
いろんなキノコはえてるけど
むやみに食べない方がいい
messages.translation:
In the mushroom forest,
there are various mushrooms growing,
but it's better not to eat them recklessly.

messages.original:
高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?
あそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・
messages.translation:
Have you seen the Noboru Kyo of Takami Yagura yet?
That scenery over there is very beautiful...

messages.original:
このキカイこわれてる・・・

たまに来る、赤い服をきたヤツなら
なおせるかもしれない
messages.translation:
This machine is broken...

If it's the guy who comes occasionally wearing a red outfit,
I might be able to fix it.

messages.original:
わし・・・見はり・・・
ちょっとたいへん・・・
messages.translation:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...

messages.original:
わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・
◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・
messages.translation:
Our ◎◎ has disappeared…
It's better if ◎ doesn't exist…

messages.original: わしらの◎◎にはもう◎△たか?

わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・
今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
Our comrades have disappeared…
It's better not to go into the forest now…

messages.original: わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?
messages.translation: Have you met our elder yet?

messages.original:
たき先といえば・・・
・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・

そういえば、
森の中でいいニオイがするんだけどねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
Speaking of firewood...
...It's yakiimo, huh...

Come to think of it,
there's a nice smell in the forest, you know...

messages.original:
おやっ!
・・・これ、くれるのかい?
うれしいねぇ・・・

そうだ、何かわからないんだけど・・・
かわりに これをもらっとくれ
messages.translation:
Oh!
...Is this what you're giving me?
I'm so happy...

Well, I don't really understand what's going on, but...
Please take this instead.

messages.original:
ケガしてるね・・・
かわいそう・・・

とがった木にぶら下がっている
ホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?
messages.translation:
Hanging from a sharp tree.
Houshi manju... Have you seen them all?

messages.original:
とがった木にぶら下がっている
ホウシまんじゅうの中に
なかま2人 とりこまれた
messages.translation:
Hanging from a sharp tree,
inside a hōshi manju,
two companions were captivated.

messages.original:
ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・
とてもあやしい・・・
messages.translation:
The swaying fern...
It's very suspicious...

messages.original:
ホウシダマがかぶさっている
木の先のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
The houjidama is overlapping.
There should be two people among the tips of the trees…

messages.original:
グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり
つかまってた・・・
messages.translation: I was caught by Guragura-sanbashi, with one companion.

messages.original:
高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん
・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・
回復する液、うまくつかわないと・・・
messages.translation:
Takami Yagura... It's wide and difficult.
... It's hard to find companions...
Recovery liquid, if you don't use it well...

messages.original:
たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま
つかまっているハズ
messages.translation: I'm sure there are two of them trapped in Takami Yagura.

messages.translation: The flowers of the biting grass.
